entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac... I hope you can help me. I need to... I need to return something. An order I received a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for a helmet. I just... I've been a loyal customer for a while and was really hoping this wouldn't be a problem.

Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's just a preference, I guess. It was a gift, and the color is just... not right for me. It's a lovely helmet, but it's been sitting in its box unopened ever since it arrived. I feel so guilty, but I really needed this money back for the holidays.
I completely understand, sometimes a color just doesn't work out. I see here the item was delivered about 32 days ago. Let me just double-check our return policy for you.
Oh, has it really been that long? I've been so stressed I lost track of time. I was so worried I might have missed the window. I really hope you can make an exception.
No exception needed at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. Since the helmet is within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. You have no idea what a relief that is. Thank you so, so much, Isaac.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label and sending it to the email on file right now. Just pack the helmet back up, attach the label, and you can drop it at any post office. Your safety is our priority, so we want to make sure you have gear you're happy with. You should see the refund in 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. I'll get it sent out this afternoon. You've really helped me out today.
Glad to hear it. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
